We must find a way to stop Godzilla! Head east along the road through the forest. The army had a post up in the mountains north of Cedar Harbor, at the far end of it. Get there before the blood moon and hole up there for the night.\n\nThe Duke
Army Field Note

Part one recovered. Hole up here for the night of the blood moon. The next part is at the army post in the mountains north of Cinder Bay: go north through the pass beside this post into the burnt forest, then follow the road west. That post still has a working missile battery; its launch control is next to the part.

Part two recovered. Hole up here for the night of the blood moon. The next part is at the army post in the mountains north of Dune Point: go north through the pass beside this post into the desert, then follow the road east.

Part three recovered. Hole up here for the night of the blood moon. The next part is at the army position in the mountains north of Frostport: go north through the pass beside this post into the snow, then follow the road west.

Part four recovered. Hole up here for the night of the blood moon. The next part is at the fortified military site in the mountains north of Ashmouth: go north through the pass beside this post into the wasteland, then follow the road east. It will be heavily guarded.\n\nThe last part of the job is by air: this crate also holds a gyrocopter chassis and accessories. Assemble a gyrocopter at a workbench (with 3 wheels, a small engine and a car battery) before the last blood moon.

That is every part. Build the Oxygen Destroyer at a workbench (with 10 electrical parts and 20 forged steel). When Godzilla comes for Ashmouth after the last blood moon, fly the gyrocopter over him with it aboard and drop it on him (right mouse button). It only goes off against him.
